I used to grow up reading about other people in SinChew (kind of an og newspaper in 2000s Ipoh I guess) and it's kinda surreal seeing my face and my work so publicly out there. When people from your hometown recognize you, that's when you've passed the point of no return. You've done it now. You're the small town girl turned into a newspaper feature. There's still a long way to go in my story folks, so don't turn off the connection just yet 🌸
W dad for making it in the paper too (he's in the pic on the left)
